1.name: sky
1.description: The sky. A pale, creamy beige across the top of the print, turning soft gray down near the horizon, with faint clouds on the right.

2.name: the great wave
2.description: The great wave. It rises on the left like a huge wall of deep blue water and curls over to the right. Its white crest breaks into claw-like fingers of foam reaching toward the boats. Smaller waves roll across the bottom and the right side.

3.name: Mount Fuji
3.description: Mount Fuji, small and far away. A snow-capped cone sitting low in the center, framed under the curl of the great wave as if the wave were about to swallow it.

4.name: boat
4.description: A long, narrow wooden boat on the left, tilted steeply as it rides up the side of the great wave. The rowers are crouched low inside it.

5.name: boat
5.description: A long boat in the middle, sliding down into the trough between waves, just below Mount Fuji. Its rowers cling to their oars.

6.name: boat
6.description: A long boat at the bottom, close to the viewer, its pink-tan hull cutting through the foam. The rowers bend low, holding on.

7.name: title panel
7.description: The title panel in the top left corner. A small rectangle of Japanese text naming the print and the series, Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji, with the artist's signature beside it.
